cleanIntro: Tisas's own 1911 strip: plug and bushing first, then the slide stop off the half-moon notch, slide forward, and the barrel lifted out. The recoil spring is under compression from the first move to the last, and the manual says so twice.

steps.title: Muzzle safe, magazine out
steps.action: Point the barrel somewhere safe and take the magazine out before anything else. Tisas puts the magazine first for the reason every 1911 manual does — work the slide first and you feed the round you were trying to remove.

steps.title: Slide open, chamber looked at
steps.action: Open the slide and actually look into the chamber. A 1911's ejection port hides a case rim from some angles, so this is eyes on the chamber, not a hand sweep.
steps.quote: Open the slide to ensure the chamber is empty and visually
steps.cite: USER MANUAL — Tisas Pistols — User Manual, Tisas Pistols — undated; no copyright line, revision code or print date appears in the 40 pages — 11. Disassembly and Assembly — Disassembly for Model 1911 A1, p.20

steps.title: Plug pressed in, bushing turned a quarter clockwise
steps.action: Press the recoil spring plug in against the spring and rotate the barrel bushing a quarter turn clockwise, which frees the plug. Keep your hand over it the whole time — the spring behind it is compressed and this is the step that launches parts across a room.
steps.caution: Keep your hand on the recoil spring as it is
steps.aside: The manual gives the bushing rotation as 90 degrees clockwise here.
steps.quote: Push the recoil spring plug in and rotate the barrel bushing
steps.cite: USER MANUAL — Tisas Pistols — User Manual, Tisas Pistols — undated; no copyright line, revision code or print date appears in the 40 pages — 11. Disassembly and Assembly — Disassembly for Model 1911 A1, p.20

steps.title: Plug out, and the spring only if it comes willingly
steps.action: Take the recoil spring plug out. If the spring lifts out easily, take it now; if it does not, Tisas says leave it installed rather than fighting it — it comes out later with the guide rod once the slide is off.
steps.aside: If the recoil spring is not easily removed, leave it installed and take it off with the guide rod after the slide is separated.
steps.cite: USER MANUAL — Tisas Pistols — User Manual, Tisas Pistols — undated; no copyright line, revision code or print date appears in the 40 pages — 11. Disassembly and Assembly — Disassembly for Model 1911 A1, p.20

steps.title: Bushing rotated back and lifted out
steps.action: Rotate the barrel bushing back counter-clockwise a quarter turn, then keep going about another eighth until it clears and lifts out. The second part of that rotation is the bit people stop short of, and then conclude the bushing is seized.
steps.aside: The manual gives this as 90 degrees back and then a further 45 degrees.
steps.quote: Rotate the barrel bushing back counter clockwise
steps.cite: USER MANUAL — Tisas Pistols — User Manual, Tisas Pistols — undated; no copyright line, revision code or print date appears in the 40 pages — 11. Disassembly and Assembly — Disassembly for Model 1911 A1, p.21

steps.title: Half-moon notch lined up, slide stop out from the right
steps.action: Push the slide slowly rearward until the half-moon detent notch lines up with the rear of the slide stop, then press the stop in from the right side and draw it out from the left. If the stop will not start, the notch is not aligned — reposition rather than force it.
steps.aside: the half moon detent notch lines up with the rear of the stop and then press the stop from the right side and pull out from the left.

steps.title: Slide run forward off the frame
steps.action: With the slide stop out, run the slide slowly forward off the frame rails, keeping hold of it as it comes clear.

steps.title: Guide rod and recoil spring out of the slide
steps.action: Lift the recoil spring guide rod out, and the recoil spring with it if you left it installed earlier.
steps.quote: Remove the recoil spring guide rod, and recoil spring if it is still

steps.title: Barrel lifted to unlock, then out of the slide
steps.action: Lift the barrel to disengage its locking lugs and draw it out of the slide. That is the strip: frame, slide, barrel, bushing, guide rod and recoil spring with its plug. Tisas publishes nothing deeper than this.
steps.quote: Lift to unlock and then remove the barrel from the slide.

deepAbsentReason: Tisas publishes one procedure in this book and it ends at the barrel — frame, slide, barrel, bushing, guide rod, recoil spring and plug. There is no firing pin, extractor, mainspring housing or fire-control procedure anywhere in the forty pages; what follows the strip is a cleaning section and then parts descriptions with exploded drawings, which are parts identification and not a teardown. Nothing deeper was invented from them.

cleaning.name: BORE & CHAMBER
tasks: Run a solvent-wet patch then a brush through the bore from the chamber end
Dry-patch until clean, then leave a light film of oil
Wipe the chamber and the feed ramp

cleaning.name: SLIDE, FRAME & RAILS
tasks: Wipe carbon from the breech face and from under the extractor
Clean the slide and frame rails, then oil them lightly
Wipe the barrel exterior, its locking lugs and the link

cleaning.name: RECOIL PARTS & BUSHING
tasks: Wipe the recoil spring, guide rod and plug; check the spring is not kinked
Wipe the inside of the barrel bushing where the barrel rides
Check the barrel link swings freely before anything goes back

reassembly: Tisas's own instruction is to reverse the disassembly.
Barrel back into the slide, lugs seated, and the link positioned correctly — the manual calls out link position twice, because a link left back stops the pistol going into battery.
Guide rod and recoil spring back in, then the bushing on and rotated to lock the barrel.
Slide onto the frame rails and run back until the half-moon notch meets the slide stop.
Slide stop in from the left through the link, seated fully.
Recoil spring plug under the bushing, pressed in and the bushing turned back over it — keep firm control, the plug is spring-driven.
fncheck: With the pistol confirmed empty, rack the slide and check it returns fully into battery, confirm the slide stop is seated flush and locks the slide back on an empty magazine, and check the thumb and grip safeties function before the pistol is carried or stored.
